stories.title: Bessent moves to curb Treasury yields, pressuring Warsh's Fed
stories.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent took new steps to curb Treasury yields, CNBC reported. The move adds pressure on the Federal Reserve under Chair Kevin Warsh.
stories.whyItMatters: Treasury action on yields can shape the Fed's rate decisions and borrowing costs across the economy.

stories.title: Fed minutes show officials saw need for a rate hike if inflation doesn't cool
stories.summary: Minutes from the Federal Reserve's latest meeting show officials discussed raising rates further. The hike would happen if inflation fails to cool, CNBC reported.
stories.whyItMatters: The minutes signal the Fed may resume rate hikes, which would raise borrowing costs and pressure equity valuations.

stories.title: China's bonds defy the global yield surge, boosting its diversification appeal
stories.summary: China's government bonds have held steady even as yields surge worldwide, CNBC reported. The divergence is boosting China's appeal as a diversification option for investors.
stories.whyItMatters: A split between Chinese and global bond yields could redirect capital flows while developed-market yields keep rising.
whatToWatch: Whether foreign inflows into Chinese bonds pick up
How long China's yields stay decoupled from the global trend
questions: What is driving China's bond stability?

stories.title: Marvell stock jumps 10% on Google AI chip deal; Broadcom falls
stories.summary: Marvell's stock rose about 10% after news of an AI chip deal with Google. The deal lets Google buy up to $12.2 billion in Marvell shares, CNBC reported. Broadcom shares fell on the news, per MarketWatch.
stories.whyItMatters: The deal reshapes the competitive picture in AI chip supply, a sector investors watch closely for winners and losers.
whatToWatch: Details on the scope and timeline of the Google-Marvell partnership
Broadcom's response and any competitive moves
questions: How large is the deal beyond the equity stake?
Does this shift Google's chip supply away from Broadcom long term?

stories.title: Dollar holds near three-month lows as Treasury moves to calm bonds
stories.summary: The dollar stayed near its lowest level in three months, Investing.com reported. The weakness follows the Treasury Department's steps to soothe the bond market.
stories.whyItMatters: A weaker dollar affects import costs, multinational earnings, and the relative appeal of US assets to foreign investors.
whatToWatch: Dollar index levels in coming sessions
Further Treasury measures aimed at bond market stability

stories.summary: The recent rally in chip stocks paused, MarketWatch reported. Some analysts still see reasons for optimism about the sector's outlook.
stories.whyItMatters: Semiconductor stocks have driven broader market gains, so a pause in the rally matters for index performance.

stories.title: SK Hynix shares surge 12% in Seoul on massive buyback plan
stories.summary: SK Hynix shares jumped more than 12% in Seoul trading, CNBC reported. The surge followed the company's announcement of a large stock buyback.
stories.whyItMatters: SK Hynix is a key memory-chip supplier for AI hardware, so this reflects broader confidence in AI-driven chip demand.
whatToWatch: Size and timeline of the buyback program

stories.whyItMatters: Positive late-stage trial data de-risks a major pipeline asset for both companies and points to a new revenue stream.

stories.title: Yields pull back from multi-year highs after Treasury doubles debt buybacks
stories.summary: Treasury yields eased from recent multi-year highs, CNBC reported. The pullback came after the Treasury Department said it would double the size of its government debt repurchase program.
stories.whyItMatters: Lower yields ease borrowing costs across the economy and can lift valuations for rate-sensitive stocks.

stories.summary: The Treasury Department said it will double the size of its debt repurchase program, CNBC reported. The move, led by Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, aims to steady the bond market.
stories.whyItMatters: A larger buyback program signals active Treasury intervention to manage bond market liquidity and yields.
whatToWatch: Implementation details and timing of the expanded buybacks

stories.whyItMatters: A short-lived bond bounce would leave the underlying pressure on yields unresolved, a concern for anyone pricing borrowing costs.
